scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm setup:aws && pnpm setup:aws:path && pnpm setup:api && pnpm setup:worker
scripts.setup:aws: [ -x .tools/aws-cli/bin/python ] || uv venv .tools/aws-cli && uv pip install --python .tools/aws-cli/bin/python --upgrade awscli
scripts.schema:types: pnpm supabase gen types typescript --project-id "${SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID:-jcufmpxjlgdfzefvulvz}" --schema public > packages/schema/supabase.ts
scripts.api:dev: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.worker:run: cd services/worker && uv run python -c "from app.handler import handler; handler({}, None)"
